title: Trust
gkm: To believe, to have faith in, to entrust oneself to; to place full confidence in.
hbm: To trust, to feel secure and unafraid; to rely on someone for safety.
refs: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee
Trust ye in the LORD for ever
The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble
